purpose: Curated walk-through galleries for the three strongest next village directions.

criteria: fills a biome family with no playable Kithkyn catalog
has a coherent complete core rather than only isolated donors
was explicitly favored during the village-roster discussion
selection.unstructured: Scouted; its strongest coherent set is Ocean Village, reserved for the later Nautical Coast gallery.

courts.title: SWAMP WETLAND
courts.subtitle: ordinary swamp / boats / overgrown timber
courts.why: The clearest unfinished biome family and the strongest set of complete donor villages.

courts.title: VIKING TAIGA
courts.subtitle: spruce halls / steep roofs / cold timber
courts.why: It gives the taiga family a strong identity and already has a coherent core kit.

courts.title: MEDITERRANEAN PLAINS
courts.subtitle: stone / plaster / tile / courtyards
courts.why: It covers the common Plains family with a distinct culture instead of another generic oak village.

verification.visualReview: Passed: separate court identities, walkable approaches, contained wetland water, no exhibit collisions.
